title: Show decoded alarm state in the Calendar text listing
description: Extend format_listing so each user appointment has an Alarm line showing on, off or <undecoded> from alarm_enabled. Add regression coverage using existing synthetic builders. Preserve JSON and parser behavior.

acceptance: Text listings show Alarm: on for True, Alarm: off for False and Alarm: <undecoded> for None.
Regression tests exercise all three states with synthetic records and assert no Alarm line is added to internal/control records.
Existing JSON output, parser interpretation, appointment ordering and all portable tests remain unchanged.
